主要内容: DISH Network Corporation issued $1 billion in 2.375% Convertible Notes due 2024 to institutional accredited investors. The Notes mature on March 15, 2024, with interest paid semi-annually starting September 15, 2017. The conversion rate is 12.1630 shares of Class A Common Stock per $1,000 principal amount, equivalent to an initial conversion price of $82.22 per share. The net proceeds are intended for strategic transactions, including wireless and spectrum-related deals, and general corporate purposes. The Notes are issued in a private placement under Section 4(a)(2) of the Securities Act. The securities are not registered and may not be offered or sold in the U.S. without registration or exemption. The filing includes a press release dated March 13, 2017, titled 'DISH Network Places $1 Billion in Convertible Notes.'
